'''''Ziziphora''''' are a genus of annual or perennial herbs or subshrubs in the family [[Lamiaceae]]. ''Ziziphora'' has [[aromatic]] leaves; they are found in open and often [[xeric]] habitats in Southern and Eastern [[Europe]], North-West [[Africa]] and [[Asia]] to the [[Himalayas]] and [[Altai Mountains]].<ref name="KEW">{{cite web | url=http://www.kew.org/herbarium/keys/lamiales/key/Interactive%20key%20to%20the%20genera%20of%20Lamiaceae/Media/Html/Ziziphora_L.htm | title=Ziziphora L. | publisher=Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew | work=Factsheets | date=2008 | access-date=8 May 2014}}</ref>
